---
title: "POMDP for Information Seeking under Threat"
output: html_document
---

<!--
CONSOLIDATED FIXES (after a long debugging trail). Four real fixes are baked in;
one proposed change was dropped as redundant.

  [KEEP] FIX A — max_time cash-out (THE root-cause bug)
         When C/I pushed the clock to max_time, done=TRUE but reward stayed 0
         (only E cashes out). A rollout that Cs to the horizon returned 0,
         discarding all fruit. Larger gamma -> cash-out point further out ->
         almost always hits the horizon -> Q(C) systematically crushed. Fixed
         in BOTH sim_step (planning) and env_step (reality): at max_time, if
         alive, bank the fruit.

  [KEEP] FIX B — greedy-with-cash-out rollout
         The plain greedy rollout (C while safe, else E) never voluntarily
         cashed out, so in safe regions it Cd to max_time. The cash-out rollout
         compares "cash out now" vs "one more C". Correct once FIX A is in.

  [KEEP] FIX C — normalized UCB
         Raw Q-values differ by >100 while the exploration term is ~1-20, so
         UCB degenerated to pure greedy (root counts like 198/1/1). Normalizing
         Q to [0,1] restores real exploration and makes c scale-free; classic
         c ~ sqrt(2) ~ 1.4 works.

  [KEEP] FIX D — max_tree_depth
         Cap tree expansion; beyond it, use rollout. Keeps the tree
         shallow-and-wide so the root actions are well-sampled. Standard POMCP.

  [DROP] "auto-scale c with reward magnitude" — redundant with FIX C, which
         already makes c independent of reward scale.

NOTE on c values: because of FIX C, the meaningful range is the classic UCT
scale c ~ {0.5, 1.4, 3}, NOT the old {5, 10, 20}.
-->

```{r setup-params}
library(dplyr)

make_params <- function(overrides = list()) {
  p <- list(
      # --- TRUE world ---
    v_animal_true   = 2,
    true_d_init     = 30,
       # --- Agent's known parameters ---
    v_sub           = 2,
    d_shelter       = 10,
    sigma_obs       = 1.0,
    sigma_proc_d    = 0.3,
    sigma_proc_v    = 0.05,
        # --- Reward and utility ---
    fruit_reward    = 10.0,
    capture_cost    = -1000,
    rho             = 1.0,
       # --- Time ---
    dt_C            = 0.2,
    dt_I            = 0.2,
    dt_E            = 0.0,
    max_time        = 40,
      # --- POMCP ---
    num_sims        = 100,
    num_particles   = 100,
    gamma           = 0.95,
    thresh          = 1e-3,
    c               = 1.4,      # FIX C: normalized-UCB scale 
    obs_bucket      = 2.0,
    max_tree_depth  = 10,       
    prior_mean_d    = 30,
    prior_sd_d      = 5,
    prior_mean_v    = 3.0,
    prior_sd_v      = 1.0
  )
  p <- modifyList(p, overrides)
  if (!("prior_mean_d" %in% names(overrides))) {
    p$prior_mean_d <- p$true_d_init
  }
  p
}

action_dt <- function(action, params) {
  switch(action, "C" = params$dt_C, "I" = params$dt_I, "E" = params$dt_E)
}
```

```{r real-state}
#----real state---------------------------------------

env_init <- function(params) {
  list(t = 0, n = 0, a = 1, d = params$true_d_init)
}

capture_threshold <- function(action, v, params) {
  base <- params$d_shelter * (v / params$v_sub - 1)
  base + v * action_dt(action, params)
}

env_step <- function(state, action, params) {
  dt <- action_dt(action, params)
  d_thresh <- capture_threshold(action, params$v_animal_true, params)
  caught   <- state$d <= d_thresh

  reward <- 0
  done   <- FALSE
  obs    <- NA_real_

  if (action == "C") {
    state$n <- state$n + 1
    if (caught) { reward <- params$capture_cost; done <- TRUE }
  } else if (action == "I") {
    obs <- rnorm(1, mean = state$d, sd = params$sigma_obs)
    if (caught) { reward <- params$capture_cost; done <- TRUE }
  } else if (action == "E") {
    reward <- if (caught) params$capture_cost
              else        (state$n ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward
    done <- TRUE
  }

  state$t <- state$t + dt
  state$d <- max(0, state$d - params$v_animal_true * dt)

  # reaching the horizon alive is a forced cash-out, not a loss.
  if (state$t >= params$max_time && !done) {
    done <- TRUE
    if (!caught) {
      reward <- reward + (state$n ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward
    }
  }

  list(state = state, reward = reward, obs = obs, done = done, caught = caught)
}
```

```{r belief-state}
#-------------belief state-------------------------------------

belief_init <- function(params) {
  data.frame(
    d = rnorm(params$num_particles, params$prior_mean_d, params$prior_sd_d),
    v = rnorm(params$num_particles, params$prior_mean_v, params$prior_sd_v)
  )
}

belief_apply_survival <- function(particles, action, params) {
  thresh_i <- capture_threshold(action, particles$v, params)
  alive    <- particles$d > thresh_i
  if (sum(alive) == 0) {
    warning("All particles inconsistent with survival.")
    return(particles)
  }
  survivors <- particles[alive, ]
  idx <- sample.int(nrow(survivors), size = nrow(particles), replace = TRUE)
  survivors[idx, ]
}

belief_propagate <- function(particles, action, params) {
  N  <- nrow(particles)
  dt <- action_dt(action, params)
  if (dt == 0) return(particles)

  sd_d <- params$sigma_proc_d * sqrt(dt)
  sd_v <- params$sigma_proc_v * sqrt(dt)
  particles$d <- pmax(0,   particles$d - particles$v * dt + rnorm(N, 0, sd_d))
  particles$v <- pmax(0.1, particles$v +                    rnorm(N, 0, sd_v))
  particles
}

belief_observe <- function(particles, obs, params) {
  if (is.na(obs)) return(particles)
  w <- dnorm(obs, mean = particles$d, sd = params$sigma_obs)
  w <- if (sum(w) == 0) rep(1 / nrow(particles), nrow(particles))
       else             w / sum(w)
  idx <- sample.int(nrow(particles), size = nrow(particles),
                    replace = TRUE, prob = w)  # importance resampling
  particles[idx, ]
}
```

```{r mcts}
#----------------- MCTS---------------

sample_hypothesis <- function(particles, observable, params) {
  i <- sample.int(nrow(particles), 1)
  list(
    t     = observable$t,
    n     = observable$n,
    d_hyp = particles$d[i],
    v_hyp = particles$v[i]
  )
}

sim_step <- function(sim_state, action, params) {
  dt <- action_dt(action, params)
  d_thresh <- capture_threshold(action, sim_state$v_hyp, params)
  caught   <- sim_state$d_hyp <= d_thresh

  reward <- 0
  done   <- FALSE
  obs    <- NA_real_

  if (action == "C") {
    sim_state$n <- sim_state$n + 1
    if (caught) { reward <- params$capture_cost; done <- TRUE }
  } else if (action == "I") {
    obs <- rnorm(1, mean = sim_state$d_hyp, sd = params$sigma_obs)
    if (caught) { reward <- params$capture_cost; done <- TRUE }
  } else if (action == "E") {
    reward <- if (caught) params$capture_cost
              else        (sim_state$n ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward
    done <- TRUE
  }

  sim_state$t     <- sim_state$t + dt
  sim_state$d_hyp <- max(0, sim_state$d_hyp - sim_state$v_hyp * dt)

  # same forced cash-out at the horizon in planning.
  if (sim_state$t >= params$max_time && !done) {
    done <- TRUE
    if (!caught) {
      reward <- reward + (sim_state$n ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward
    }
  }

  list(state = sim_state, reward = reward, obs = obs, done = done)
}

obs_to_bucket <- function(obs, params) {
  if (is.na(obs)) return("Z")
  sprintf("O%d", round(obs / params$obs_bucket))
}
```

```{r rollout}
#--------------rollout (greedy-with-cash-out)---------------------
# Treats the sampled hypothesis (d_hyp, v_hyp) as ground truth and either
# cashes out (E) or takes one more C, whichever is worth more. With FIX A in
# sim_step, hitting the horizon now banks fruit instead of returning 0, so this
# rollout gives correct, high-value leaf estimates in safe regions.

rollout <- function(sim_state, time_elapsed, params) {
  if (time_elapsed >= params$max_time)             return(0)  # horizon
  if (params$gamma ^ time_elapsed < params$thresh) return(0)  # discount floor

  q_E_now <- (sim_state$n ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward

  d_thresh_C <- capture_threshold("C", sim_state$v_hyp, params)
  if (sim_state$d_hyp <= d_thresh_C) {
    a <- "E"                                   # next C lethal -> flee
  } else {
    q_C_then_E <- (params$gamma ^ params$dt_C) *
                  ((sim_state$n + 1) ^ params$rho) * params$fruit_reward
    a <- if (q_C_then_E > q_E_now) "C" else "E"
  }

  res <- sim_step(sim_state, a, params)
  if (res$done) return(res$reward)

  dt <- action_dt(a, params)
  res$reward + (params$gamma ^ dt) *
                rollout(res$state, time_elapsed + dt, params)
}
```

```{r pomcp-tree}
#---------------------POMCP TREE (FIX C normalized UCB + FIX D depth cap)----

make_tree <- function() new.env(parent = emptyenv())

expand_node <- function(tree, hkey, actions) {
  tree[[hkey]] <- list(
    values = setNames(rep(0,  length(actions)), actions),
    counts = setNames(rep(0L, length(actions)), actions),
    total  = 0L
  )
}

# normalize Q to [0,1] before adding the exploration term, so a single
# fixed c works regardless of reward scale (classic c ~ sqrt(2) ~ 1.4).
ucb_action <- function(tree, hkey, c) {
  node   <- tree[[hkey]]
  acts   <- names(node$counts)
  counts <- node$counts
  if (any(counts == 0)) return(sample(acts[counts == 0], 1))

  v  <- node$values
  vr <- range(v)
  v_norm <- if (diff(vr) > 0) (v - vr[1]) / diff(vr) else rep(0.5, length(v))

  scores <- v_norm + c * sqrt(log(node$total) / counts)
  sample(acts[scores == max(scores)], 1)
}

# `depth` caps tree expansion; beyond max_tree_depth use rollout.
simulate_tree <- function(tree, sim_state, hkey, time_elapsed, params,
                          depth = 0) {
  if (time_elapsed >= params$max_time)             return(0)
  if (params$gamma ^ time_elapsed < params$thresh) return(0)
  if (depth >= params$max_tree_depth) {
    return(rollout(sim_state, time_elapsed, params))
  }

  if (is.null(tree[[hkey]])) {
    expand_node(tree, hkey, c("C", "I", "E"))
    a   <- sample(c("C", "I", "E"), 1)
    res <- sim_step(sim_state, a, params)
    R   <- res$reward
    if (!res$done) {
      dt <- action_dt(a, params)
      R  <- R + (params$gamma ^ dt) *
                rollout(res$state, time_elapsed + dt, params)
    }
    node           <- tree[[hkey]]
    node$counts[a] <- 1L
    node$total     <- 1L
    node$values[a] <- R
    tree[[hkey]]   <- node
    return(R)
  }

  a   <- ucb_action(tree, hkey, params$c)
  res <- sim_step(sim_state, a, params)
  R   <- res$reward

  if (!res$done) {
    dt <- action_dt(a, params)
    child_hkey <- paste0(hkey, "|", a, "|", obs_to_bucket(res$obs, params))
    R <- R + (params$gamma ^ dt) *
              simulate_tree(tree, res$state, child_hkey,
                            time_elapsed + dt, params, depth + 1)
  }

  node           <- tree[[hkey]]
  node$counts[a] <- node$counts[a] + 1L
  node$total     <- node$total + 1L
  node$values[a] <- node$values[a] + (R - node$values[a]) / node$counts[a]
  tree[[hkey]]   <- node
  R
}

search_pomcp <- function(observable, particles, params) {
  tree <- make_tree()
  expand_node(tree, "root", c("C", "I", "E"))

  for (i in seq_len(params$num_sims)) {
    sim_state <- sample_hypothesis(particles, observable, params)
    simulate_tree(tree, sim_state, "root", 0, params, depth = 0)
  }

  node     <- tree[["root"]]
  best_act <- names(node$values)[which.max(node$values)]
  list(action = best_act, q = node$values, counts = node$counts,
       tree_size = length(ls(tree)))
}
```

```{r episode-loop}
#--------------------EPISODE LOOP-------------------

run_episode <- function(params, verbose = FALSE) {
  true_state <- env_init(params)
  particles  <- belief_init(params)
  traj <- list()

  repeat {
    observable <- list(t = true_state$t, n = true_state$n)

    sr     <- search_pomcp(observable, particles, params)
    action <- sr$action                       # plain argmax
    qvals  <- sr$q

    res <- env_step(true_state, action, params)

    if (!res$done || !res$caught) {
      particles <- belief_apply_survival(particles, action, params)
      particles <- belief_propagate(particles, action, params)
      if (action == "I") particles <- belief_observe(particles, res$obs, params)
    }

    traj[[length(traj) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      t          = res$state$t,
      action     = action,
      Q_C        = unname(qvals["C"]),
      Q_I        = unname(qvals["I"]),
      Q_E        = unname(qvals["E"]),
      n_C        = unname(sr$counts["C"]),
      n_I        = unname(sr$counts["I"]),
      n_E        = unname(sr$counts["E"]),
      tree_size  = sr$tree_size,
      mu_d       = mean(particles$d),
      sd_d       = sd(particles$d),
      mu_v       = mean(particles$v),
      sd_v       = sd(particles$v),
      true_d     = res$state$d,
      obs        = res$obs,
      reward     = res$reward,
      caught     = res$caught,
      done       = res$done,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    if (verbose) {
      cat(sprintf(
        "t=%5.2f  a=%s  true_d=%5.2f  d=%5.2f±%4.2f  v=%4.2f±%4.2f  Q=(C:%7.1f I:%7.1f E:%7.1f)  tree=%4d  r=%5.0f%s\n",
        res$state$t, action, res$state$d,
        mean(particles$d), sd(particles$d),
        mean(particles$v), sd(particles$v),
        qvals["C"], qvals["I"], qvals["E"], sr$tree_size, res$reward,
        if (res$caught) "  CAUGHT" else ""
      ))
    }

    true_state <- res$state
    if (res$done) break
  }

  do.call(rbind, traj)
}
```

```{r grid-search}
#--------------grid search --------

library(future)
library(future.apply)

eval_cell <- function(i, param_grid, n_episodes, base_params) {
  param_names <- names(param_grid)
  cur <- base_params
  for (nm in param_names) cur[[nm]] <- param_grid[[nm]][i]
  if ("true_d_init" %in% param_names &&
      !("prior_mean_d" %in% param_names)) {
    cur$prior_mean_d <- cur$true_d_init
  }

  ep_rewards <- numeric(n_episodes)
  ep_fruits  <- numeric(n_episodes)
  n_I_used   <- numeric(n_episodes)
  n_C_used   <- numeric(n_episodes)
  survived_v <- logical(n_episodes)

  for (e in seq_len(n_episodes)) {
    tr <- run_episode(cur)
    ep_rewards[e] <- sum(tr$reward, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_I_used[e]   <- sum(tr$action == "I")
    n_C_used[e]   <- sum(tr$action == "C")
    surv          <- !any(tr$caught)
    survived_v[e] <- surv
    ep_fruits[e]  <- if (surv) sum(tr$action == "C") else 0
  }

  p_surv <- mean(survived_v)
  row <- as.data.frame(as.list(param_grid[i, , drop = FALSE]))
  row$mean_reward  <- mean(ep_rewards)
  row$sd_reward    <- sd(ep_rewards)
  row$survival_pct <- 100 * p_surv
  row$se_survival  <- 100 * sqrt(p_surv * (1 - p_surv) / n_episodes)
  row$mean_fruits  <- mean(ep_fruits)
  row$sd_fruits    <- sd(ep_fruits)
  row$mean_n_I     <- mean(n_I_used)
  row$sd_n_I       <- sd(n_I_used)
  row$mean_n_C     <- mean(n_C_used)
  row
}

run_grid_search <- function(param_grid, n_episodes, base_params,
                            workers = NULL) {
  if (is.null(workers)) {
    sc <- Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK")
    workers <- if (nzchar(sc)) {
      as.integer(sc)
    } else {
      omp <- Sys.getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS")
      if (nzchar(omp)) as.integer(omp) else parallel::detectCores()
    }
  }
  cat("GRID SEARCH WORKERS =", workers, "\n")              
  message(sprintf("Grid search: %d cells on %d workers (multicore).",
                  nrow(param_grid), workers))

  plan(multicore, workers = workers)                        
  on.exit(plan(sequential), add = TRUE)

  rows <- future.apply::future_lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(param_grid)),
    eval_cell,
    param_grid  = param_grid,
    n_episodes  = n_episodes,
    base_params = base_params,
    future.seed = TRUE
  )
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

```{r fig-shared-setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(future)
library(future.apply)

# ---- precision (raise for final figures) ----
FIG_N_EP  <- 5
FIG_NSIMS <- 100
FIG_NPART <- 100

# ---- ONE evaluator used by both figures: a parameter point -> 3 metrics + SE
eval_point <- function(overrides, n_ep = FIG_N_EP) {
  cur <- make_params(c(overrides, list(num_sims = FIG_NSIMS,
                                       num_particles = FIG_NPART,
                                       max_tree_depth = 10, c = 1.4)))
  nC <- nI <- numeric(n_ep); surv <- logical(n_ep)
  for (e in seq_len(n_ep)) {
    tr <- run_episode(cur)
    nC[e]   <- sum(tr$action == "C")
    nI[e]   <- sum(tr$action == "I")
    surv[e] <- !any(tr$caught)
  }
  p <- mean(surv)
  data.frame(
    mean_n_I     = mean(nI), se_n_I  = sd(nI) / sqrt(n_ep),
    mean_n_C     = mean(nC), se_n_C  = sd(nC) / sqrt(n_ep),
    survival_pct = 100 * p,  se_surv = 100 * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_ep)
  )
}

# ---- ONE worker-detection scheme (3-layer), used by both collections ----
detect_workers <- function() {
  sc <- Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK")
  if (nzchar(sc)) return(as.integer(sc))
  omp <- Sys.getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS")
  if (nzchar(omp)) return(as.integer(omp))
  parallel::detectCores()
}

# ---- ONE shared theme ----
theme_paper <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.line  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

# ---- ONE long-reshape helper (renamed to avoid any collision) ----
# Pulls the three metric columns of a wide result frame into long form.
to_long_metrics <- function(df, extra_cols = character(0)) {
  base_cols <- c(extra_cols)
  spec <- list(
    c("mean_n_I",     "se_n_I",  "Information-seeks (n_I)"),
    c("mean_n_C",     "se_n_C",  "Fruits collected (n_C)"),
    c("survival_pct", "se_surv", "Survival (%)")
  )
  do.call(rbind, lapply(spec, function(s) {
    out <- df[, base_cols, drop = FALSE]
    out$value  <- df[[s[1]]]
    out$se     <- df[[s[2]]]
    out$metric <- s[3]
    out
  }))
}

metric_levels <- c("Information-seeks (n_I)",
                   "Fruits collected (n_C)",
                   "Survival (%)")
```

```{r fig1-maineffect-collect}
#============================================================================
# FIGURE 1 data — main effects (single slice).
# Each parameter swept while the OTHERS stay at a fixed baseline.
#============================================================================
PM_BASE <- list(gamma = 0.95)

build_pm_grid <- function() {
  rows <- list()
  # sweep 1: observation noise (v_sub=1.5 mildly risky, fruit=10)
  for (so in c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0))
    rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "sigma_obs", x = so,
      ov = c(PM_BASE, list(sigma_obs = so, v_sub = 1.5, fruit_reward = 10)))
  # sweep 2: fruit reward (v_sub=1.5, sigma_obs=1.0)
  for (fr in c(10, 50, 100))
    rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "fruit_reward", x = fr,
      ov = c(PM_BASE, list(fruit_reward = fr, v_sub = 1.5, sigma_obs = 1.0)))
  # sweep 3: subject speed (sigma_obs=1.0, fruit=10)
  for (vs in c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0))
    rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "v_sub", x = vs,
      ov = c(PM_BASE, list(v_sub = vs, sigma_obs = 1.0, fruit_reward = 10)))
  rows
}
PM_GRID <- build_pm_grid()

workers <- detect_workers()
cat("FIG1 WORKERS =", workers, "\n")
cat("fork supported:", future::supportsMulticore(), "\n")
plan(multicore, workers = workers)

pm_results <- future.apply::future_lapply(
  PM_GRID,
  function(pt) cbind(param = pt$param, x = pt$x, eval_point(pt$ov)),
  future.seed = TRUE
)
plan(sequential)

PM <- do.call(rbind, pm_results)
cat("FIG1 grid points:", length(PM_GRID), "\n")
print(PM)
```

```{r fig1-maineffect-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=11}
PM_long <- to_long_metrics(PM, extra_cols = c("param", "x"))

PM_long$param  <- factor(PM_long$param,
                         levels = c("sigma_obs", "fruit_reward", "v_sub"),
                         labels = c("sigma[obs]", "Fruit~reward", "v[sub]"))
PM_long$metric <- factor(PM_long$metric, levels = metric_levels)

metric_cols <- c("Information-seeks (n_I)" = "#1a9641",
                 "Fruits collected (n_C)"  = "#e66101",
                 "Survival (%)"            = "#d7191c")

fig1 <- ggplot(PM_long, aes(x = x, y = value, color = metric, group = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se), size = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metric_cols) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ param, scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(param = label_parsed)) +
  labs(title = "Main effects: task parameters on model behavior",
       x = "Parameter value", y = NULL) +
  theme_paper + theme(legend.position = "none")

print(fig1)
ggsave("param_metric_grid.png", fig1, width = 13, height = 11,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r fig2-interaction-collect}
#============================================================================
# FIGURE 2 data — interactions (double slice).
# Each sweep crossed with a grouping variable:
#   sigma_obs, fruit_reward -> grouped by v_sub
#   v_sub                   -> grouped by sigma_obs
#============================================================================
DS_BASE   <- list(gamma = 0.95, fruit_reward = 10, sigma_obs = 1.0)
VSUB_GRID <- c(1.5, 2.0, 2.5)
SOBS_GRID <- c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0)

build_ds_grid <- function() {
  rows <- list()
  # Sweep A: sigma_obs x v_sub  (group_var = v_sub)
  for (vs in VSUB_GRID)
    for (so in c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0))
      rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "sigma_obs", x = so,
        group_var = "v_sub", group = vs,
        ov = list(gamma = DS_BASE$gamma, sigma_obs = so, v_sub = vs,
                  fruit_reward = DS_BASE$fruit_reward))
  # Sweep B: fruit_reward x v_sub  (group_var = v_sub)
  for (vs in VSUB_GRID)
    for (fr in c(10, 50, 100))
      rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "fruit_reward", x = fr,
        group_var = "v_sub", group = vs,
        ov = list(gamma = DS_BASE$gamma, fruit_reward = fr, v_sub = vs,
                  sigma_obs = DS_BASE$sigma_obs))
  # Sweep C: v_sub x sigma_obs  (group_var = sigma_obs)
  for (so in SOBS_GRID)
    for (vs in c(1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0))
      rows[[length(rows)+1]] <- list(param = "v_sub", x = vs,
        group_var = "sigma_obs", group = so,
        ov = list(gamma = DS_BASE$gamma, v_sub = vs, sigma_obs = so,
                  fruit_reward = DS_BASE$fruit_reward))
  rows
}
DS_GRID <- build_ds_grid()

workers <- detect_workers()
cat("FIG2 WORKERS =", workers, "\n")
plan(multicore, workers = workers)

ds_results <- future.apply::future_lapply(
  DS_GRID,
  function(pt) cbind(param = pt$param, x = pt$x,
                     group_var = pt$group_var, group = pt$group,
                     eval_point(pt$ov)),
  future.seed = TRUE
)
plan(sequential)

DS <- do.call(rbind, ds_results)
cat("FIG2 grid points:", length(DS_GRID), "\n")
print(head(DS, 12))
```

```{r fig2-interaction-plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=11}
# ---- reshape, then build a clear "group_var = value" label ----
DS_long <- to_long_metrics(DS, extra_cols = c("param", "x",
                                              "group_var", "group"))

# human-readable grouping label, e.g. "v[sub]==1.5" / "sigma[obs]==0.5"
# (parsed as plotmath so the subscripts render)
DS_long$group_label <- ifelse(
  DS_long$group_var == "v_sub",
  paste0("v[sub]==", DS_long$group),
  paste0("sigma[obs]==", DS_long$group)
)
# order labels: all v_sub levels first, then all sigma_obs levels
lab_levels <- c(
  paste0("v[sub]==",     sort(unique(DS$group[DS$group_var == "v_sub"]))),
  paste0("sigma[obs]==", sort(unique(DS$group[DS$group_var == "sigma_obs"])))
)
DS_long$group_label <- factor(DS_long$group_label, levels = lab_levels)

DS_long$param  <- factor(DS_long$param,
                         levels = c("sigma_obs", "fruit_reward", "v_sub"),
                         labels = c("sigma[obs]~(group:~v[sub])",
                                    "Fruit~reward~(group:~v[sub])",
                                    "v[sub]~(group:~sigma[obs])"))
DS_long$metric <- factor(DS_long$metric, levels = metric_levels)

# enough distinct colours for ALL labels (3 v_sub + 3 sigma_obs = up to 6);
# viridis auto-scales to however many are present.
fig2 <- ggplot(DS_long, aes(x = x, y = value,
                            color = group_label, group = group_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = value - se, ymax = value + se),
                  size = 0.35, position = position_dodge(width = 0.04)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "grouping value", labels = scales::parse_format()) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ param, scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(param = label_parsed)) +
  labs(title = "Interactions: task-parameter effects vs a grouping variable",
       subtitle = "Each column is grouped by a different variable (see facet titles); other params at baseline",
       x = "Parameter value", y = NULL) +
  theme_paper + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(fig2)
ggsave("double_slice_grid.png", fig2, width = 14, height = 11,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r optimal-hparam-setup}
#============================================================================
# OPTIMAL SUBJECTIVE-HYPERPARAMETER SEARCH  (Interpretation A)
#----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# c, gamma, fruit_reward are the AGENT's subjective cognitive parameters, NOT
# environment settings. Different agents value fruit / weight the future /
# explore differently. There is therefore no "reward-optimal" value: the
# agent's own fruit_reward would make reward self-referential (a larger
# subjective fruit value inflates the reward it is scored by).
#
# So we score configurations by OBJECTIVE behaviour only:
#   survival_pct  — did it actually escape alive?
#   mean_n_C      — how many fruits did it actually pick?
# combined into:
#   objective_yield = (survival_pct/100) * mean_n_C
#     = expected fruits actually carried to safety per episode.
#   (Captured episodes yield nothing objectively, so survival-weighting
#    naturally penalises "greedy high-fruit_reward gets you killed".)
#
# The OBJECTIVE WORLD is held fixed across all configs (v_animal_true,
# true_d_init, v_sub, etc.) — we are asking "which cognition is best adapted
# to THIS world", so the world cannot move. Only subjective params vary.
#
# Parallel (multicore), self-contained.
#============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(future.apply)

# ---- precision ----
OPT_N_EP  <- 5
OPT_NSIMS <- 100
OPT_NPART <- 100

# ---- FIXED objective world (NOT searched — this is the real environment) ----
# Everything here describes the true task; subjective params are layered on top.
FIXED_WORLD <- list(
  v_animal_true = 2,      # true predator speed
  true_d_init   = 30,     # true starting distance
  v_sub         = 2,      # subject's (true) speed capability
  d_shelter     = 10,
  sigma_obs     = 1.0,    # true observation noise of the task
  sigma_proc_d  = 0.3,
  sigma_proc_v  = 0.05,
  dt_C = 0.2, dt_I = 0.2, dt_E = 0.0,
  max_time = 40,
  prior_mean_d  = 30,     # biased prior: agent slightly UNDER-estimates the
                          # true distance (30), i.e. believes the predator is
                          # a bit closer than it is -> mildly cautious start.
  prior_sd_d    = 5       # prior uncertainty on distance (held fixed)
)

# ---- evaluator: one config -> objective metrics (NO reward used to score) ----
eval_config <- function(overrides, n_ep = OPT_N_EP) {
  cur <- make_params(c(FIXED_WORLD, overrides,
                       list(num_sims = OPT_NSIMS, num_particles = OPT_NPART,
                            max_tree_depth = 10)))
  nC <- numeric(n_ep); surv <- logical(n_ep)
  for (e in seq_len(n_ep)) {
    tr <- run_episode(cur)
    nC[e]   <- sum(tr$action == "C")
    surv[e] <- !any(tr$caught)
  }
  p <- mean(surv)
  data.frame(
    survival_pct    = 100 * p,
    se_survival     = 100 * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n_ep),
    mean_n_C        = mean(nC),
    se_n_C          = sd(nC) / sqrt(n_ep),
    objective_yield = p * mean(nC)            # survival-weighted fruit
  )
}

# ---- the subjective search space ----
opt_grid <- expand.grid(
  c            = c(0.5, 1.4, 3.0),   # exploration (normalized-UCB scale)
  gamma        = c(0.90, 0.95, 0.99),# subjective patience / temporal discount
  fruit_reward = c(10, 50, 100)      # subjective value of a fruit
)
cat("Configurations to evaluate:", nrow(opt_grid), "\n")
```

```{r optimal-hparam-search}
# ---- worker detection (same 3-layer scheme as the rest of the project) ----
workers <- {
  sc <- Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK")
  if (nzchar(sc)) as.integer(sc) else {
    omp <- Sys.getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS")
    if (nzchar(omp)) as.integer(omp) else parallel::detectCores()
  }
}
cat("OPT SEARCH WORKERS =", workers, "\n")
cat("fork supported:", future::supportsMulticore(), "\n")
plan(multicore, workers = workers)

opt_rows <- future.apply::future_lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(opt_grid)),
  function(i) {
    ov <- list(c = opt_grid$c[i], gamma = opt_grid$gamma[i],
               fruit_reward = opt_grid$fruit_reward[i])
    cbind(opt_grid[i, , drop = FALSE], eval_config(ov))
  },
  future.seed = TRUE
)
plan(sequential)

OPT <- do.call(rbind, opt_rows)
```

```{r optimal-hparam-report}
library(dplyr)

# ---- rank by the objective yield (survival-weighted fruit) ----
cat("=== Top configurations by objective_yield (survival x fruit) ===\n")
OPT %>% arrange(desc(objective_yield)) %>% head(12) %>% print()

cat("\n=== Best single configuration ===\n")
best <- OPT %>% arrange(desc(objective_yield)) %>% slice(1)
print(best)
cat(sprintf(
  "\nBest: c=%.1f, gamma=%.2f, fruit_reward=%g  ->  survival=%.0f%%, n_C=%.1f, yield=%.1f\n",
  best$c, best$gamma, best$fruit_reward,
  best$survival_pct, best$mean_n_C, best$objective_yield))

# ---- diagnostic: does subjective fruit_reward overshoot? (your hypothesis) ----
# Higher subjective fruit value can make the agent greedier -> caught more ->
# objective yield can DROP even though it "wants" fruit more. Show the trend.
cat("\n=== Effect of subjective fruit_reward (averaged over c, gamma) ===\n")
OPT %>% group_by(fruit_reward) %>%
  summarize(mean_survival = mean(survival_pct),
            mean_n_C      = mean(mean_n_C),
            mean_yield    = mean(objective_yield),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()
cat("If mean_survival falls and mean_yield peaks at an intermediate\n",
    "fruit_reward, that confirms: over-valuing fruit gets the agent killed.\n")

# ---- marginal effect of each subjective parameter on objective yield ----
cat("\n=== Marginal objective_yield by gamma ===\n")
OPT %>% group_by(gamma) %>%
  summarize(mean_yield = mean(objective_yield),
            mean_survival = mean(survival_pct), .groups="drop") %>% print()

cat("\n=== Marginal objective_yield by c ===\n")
OPT %>% group_by(c) %>%
  summarize(mean_yield = mean(objective_yield),
            mean_survival = mean(survival_pct), .groups="drop") %>% print()
```
